text:
sophie-finance: Heads-up everyone 1 new delegated-approval policy live now. Short version: team leads can approve vendor spend up to $3k; managers up to $15k with a one-line biz justification; $15k+ follows standard PO + legal flow. Full doc: https://redwood.company/finance/delegated-approvals :memo:

procurement-bot: POLICY UPDATE by @sophie-finance
- <=$3k: team lead approval, virtual card encouraged
- $3k15k: manager approval + cost center; attach invoice
- >$15k: finance manager + PO; >$50k: legal required
- Recurring subs: flag as "recurring" in request; renewals reviewed 30 days out

dan-eng: quick Q 1 lead + manager both out. Can an IC submit with exec note?

sophie-finance: yes 1 use the `Exec exception` checkbox and paste an exec Slack note; approvals auto-route to `#finance-escalations`. Keep receipts attached.

maya-hr: for new vendors that handle PII, do we still need procurement + security sign-off even if under $3k?

procurement-bot: Security sign-off is required for vendors that process PII or PHI regardless of amount. Use `/procure onboard` and attach the privacy checklist.

cto-jess: Sophie, can we add an SLA indicator on the form? Engineers need to know expected turnaround times.

procurement-bot: SLA estimates: team-level <=48hrs, manager-level 23 business days, finance-level up to 5 business days. Escalations aim for 24hrs.

dan-eng: great, thanks. Will update our onboarding doc and remind my team to include GL codes.

sophie-finance: GL quick list in the doc: infra=GL-4001, product=GL-4100, marketing=GL-4203. If unsure, use GL-9999. We'll reassign.

procurement-bot: policy version: 2026-04-02_delegated_v1. Archived prior at https://redwood.company/finance/archive

sophie-finance: I'll host a 15-min drop-in tomorrow 10am PT for folks who approve purchases frequently. Link in #all-hands. Drop corner cases here.

dan-eng: thanks, see you then :thumbsup:
